theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 13 群

items.colloc: a raised flower bed 高架花壇 | maintain the flower bed 維護花壇
items.distinct: planter 盆栽；花盆 | garden 花園
ex: The landscaping team is cleaning the flower bed.
景觀團隊正在清理花壇。
New flowers were planted in the office flower bed.
辦公室花圃種了些新花。
Please do not step into the flower bed.
請不要踏入花壇區域。

items.colloc: suffer from food poisoning 遭受食物中毒 | prevent food poisoning 預防食物中毒
items.distinct: indigestion 消化不良 | allergic reaction 過敏反應
ex: Several guests suffered from food poisoning after the banquet.
晚宴後幾位賓客發生了食物中毒。
The restaurant was closed due to a food poisoning incident.
該餐廳因食物中毒事件而暫停營業。
She took leave because of suspected food poisoning.
她因為疑似食物中毒而請假。

items.colloc: haven't seen for ages 好久不見 | wait for ages 等了很久
items.distinct: for a long time 很長時間 | in ages 好一段時間沒做某事
ex: We have not updated our software for ages.
我們已經好久沒更新軟體了。
The project has been pending for ages.
這個專案已經懸置許久了。
They have been waiting for ages for the shipment.
他們等這批貨已經等了很久。

items.colloc: provide a forwarding address 提供轉寄地址 | leave a forwarding address 留下轉寄地址
items.distinct: mailing address 通訊地址 | registered address 登記地址
ex: Please provide your forwarding address before moving out.
搬離前請提供您的轉寄地址。
We need a forwarding address for the client's mail.
我們需要客戶郵件的轉寄地址。
The tenant did not leave a forwarding address behind.
房客離開時未留下轉寄地址。

items.colloc: get a ride to the airport 搭車去機場 | offer to get a ride 提供載送
items.distinct: catch a ride 搭乘交通工具 | give a lift 載某人一程
ex: Can I get a ride to the meeting venue?
我可以搭車前往會議地點嗎？
He managed to get a ride with a colleague.
他設法搭了同事的便車。
We will get a ride home after the office party.
辦公室派對後我們會搭車回家。

items.colloc: get lost in the city 在城市裡迷路 | easily get lost 容易迷路
items.distinct: lose one's way 迷失方向 | be stranded 受困
ex: The courier got lost while searching for the building.
快遞員在尋找大樓時迷路了。
I always get lost when visiting this large complex.
造訪這個大型園區時我總是會迷路。
Do not get lost in the details of the contract.
別在合約細節中迷失方向。

items.pos: phr. 克服；恢復；從...中走出來
items.colloc: get over a problem 克服問題 | get over the illness 從疾病中恢復
items.distinct: overcome 克服困難 | recover from 從...恢復
ex: It took them weeks to get over the financial crisis.
他們花了數週才熬過財務危機。
We need to get over this hurdle to move forward.
我們必須克服這個障礙才能繼續前進。
She is trying to get over her fear of public speaking.
她正在努力克服公開演講的恐懼。

items.colloc: get rid of waste 處理廢棄物 | get rid of old equipment 處置舊設備
items.distinct: discard 丟棄 | dispose of 處置
ex: We should get rid of all the outdated files.
我們應該將所有過期的檔案處理掉。
The manager wants to get rid of unnecessary expenses.
經理想要削減不必要的開支。
They need to get rid of the chemical waste properly.
他們需要妥善處理化學廢棄物。

items.pos: phr. 明白要點；理解用意
items.colloc: fail to get the point 未能理解重點 | clearly get the point 明確理解意思
items.distinct: miss the point 沒抓到重點 | make a point 提出觀點
ex: He eventually got the point of the new strategy.
他最終理解了新策略的重點。
Did you get the point of her presentation today?
你有聽懂她今天簡報的重點嗎？
I hope the team gets the point of these changes.
我希望團隊能明白這些變動的用意。

items.pos: phr. 完成；熬過；接通（電話）
items.colloc: get through the work 完成工作 | get through the busy season 熬過旺季
items.distinct: finish 完成 | survive 存活；熬過
ex: I have so much paperwork to get through today.
我今天有很多文書工作要完成。
It is difficult to get through to the main office.
很難接通總公司的電話。
We can get through this difficult economic period together.
我們可以一起熬過這段艱難的經濟時期。

items.pos: phr. 到達；開始做；有機會做
items.colloc: get to work 開始工作 | get to the office 到達辦公室
items.distinct: arrive at 到達 | reach 到達
ex: I will get to the meeting as soon as possible.
我會儘快趕到會議現場。
When can we get to the discussion of the budget?
我們什麼時候可以開始討論預算？
I finally get to visit the factory branch next week.
下週我終於有機會參觀工廠分部了。

items.colloc: redeem a gift certificate 兌換禮券 | purchase a gift certificate 購買禮券
items.distinct: voucher 憑證；折價券 | coupon 優惠券
ex: The employee received a gift certificate as a bonus.
員工收到了一份禮券作為獎金。
You can use this gift certificate at any store branch.
您可以在任何分店使用這張禮券。
We offer a gift certificate for loyal customers.
我們為忠實客戶提供禮券。

items.colloc: make sure to follow 務必遵守 | make sure that 確保...
items.distinct: ensure 確保 | confirm 確認
ex: Please make sure to sign the documents before leaving.
離開前請務必確認簽署文件。
I will make sure the equipment is properly stored.
我會確保設備妥善存放。
Make sure that all the guests are registered online.
務必確認所有賓客皆已線上報名。

items.colloc: willing to give it a try 願意嘗試 | worth giving it a try 值得一試
items.distinct: make an attempt 做出嘗試 | have a go 試試看
ex: Why not give it a try and see the results?
為什麼不試試看並觀察結果呢？
He decided to give it a try despite the risks.
儘管有風險，他還是決定嘗試一下。
I am not sure, but I will give it a try.
我不確定，但我會試試看。

items.colloc: give off heat 發熱 | give off a smell 散發氣味
items.distinct: emit 發射；散發 | release 釋放
ex: The old machine began to give off a strange smell.
那台舊機器開始散發出奇怪的味道。
These bulbs give off a very bright white light.
這些燈泡會發出非常明亮的白光。
The chemical reaction may give off toxic fumes.
化學反應可能會散發出毒氣。

items.colloc: give way to traffic 禮讓車流 | give way to new technology 被新技術取代
items.distinct: yield 讓路 | surrender 投降；屈服
ex: Drivers must give way to pedestrians at the crossing.
駕駛在路口必須禮讓行人。
Manual systems are slowly giving way to automation.
手動系統正逐漸被自動化取代。
The old building will give way to a new skyscraper.
舊建築將被拆除以興建摩天大樓。

items.colloc: apply for a government grant 申請政府補助 | receive a government grant 獲得補助
items.distinct: subsidy 津貼 | loan 貸款
ex: The startup company applied for a government grant.
這家新創公司申請了政府補助金。
Research projects are often funded by government grants.
研究專案通常由政府撥款資助。
We met the requirements for the government grant program.
我們符合政府補助計畫的資格要求。

items.pos: phr. 吃點東西；隨便吃點
items.colloc: grab a bite to eat 隨便吃點東西 | grab a quick bite 快速吃點東西
items.distinct: have a meal 用餐 | dine out 外出用餐
ex: Let us grab a bite before the afternoon session.
下午場開始前我們去吃點東西吧。
There is no time, so I will just grab a bite.
沒時間了，我只能隨便吃點。
We can grab a bite at the cafeteria nearby.
我們可以到附近的餐廳隨便吃點。

items.colloc: high growth potential 高成長潛力 | evaluate growth potential 評估發展潛力
items.distinct: market prospect 市場前景 | business opportunity 商機
ex: Our company shows great growth potential this year.
我們公司今年展現出極大的成長潛力。
Investors are looking for startups with growth potential.
投資者正在尋找具有成長潛力的新創公司。
We need to assess the growth potential of this market.
我們需要評估這個市場的成長潛力。

items.pos: phr. 閒晃；聚在一起；花時間
items.colloc: hang out with colleagues 與同事聚會 | hang out at the office 在辦公室閒聊
items.distinct: socialize 社交 | spend time 花時間
ex: They usually hang out at the cafe after work.
他們下班後常在咖啡廳聚會。
It is nice to hang out with the team outside.
能在外面跟團隊聚聚真不錯。
We often hang out in the lounge during breaks.
休息時間我們常在休息室閒聊。
